newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Eleven children killed in Malaysian fire.
newsitem.headline: Eleven children killed in Malaysian fire.

text.p: Eleven primary schoolchildren were burnt to death early on Wednesday in a fire that engulfed their hostel in Malaysia's Borneo state of Sarawak, the national news agency Bernama said.

Bernama quoted fire department officials in the town of Saratok as saying the fire had nearly burnt itself out by the time firemen arrived in the village of Kampung Sessang in the remote interior of Sarawak, a state mostly covered by rainforests.
It said 18 pupils were sleeping in the hostel at the time of the fire.
Kampung Sessang is about 60 km (37 miles) from Saratok, which is about 310 km (192 miles) north of the state capital, Kuching.
